description: Generate exact-pinned uv/Django/DRF Python scaffold with pyproject.toml, uv.lock, runtime pin, local ignores, and matching starter.json (subtask 3.1)
steps: Initialize with uv: run `uv init` in the django-api-backend directory, then configure pyproject.toml with exact-pinned Django 5.1.x, djangorestframework, django-allauth, drf-spectacular, stripe, psycopg[binary], django-cors-headers, django-ratelimit, structlog, gunicorn, and dev dependencies (pytest, pytest-django, hypothesis, ruff, mypy, django-stubs, djangorestframework-stubs, factory-boy, httpx)
Pin Python version to 3.12 in pyproject.toml requires-python and .python-version file
Create .gitignore for Python (*.pyc, __pycache__, .venv, *.egg-info, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, db.sqlite3, .env, dist/, build/)

Create django-api-backend/starter.json matching catalog entry id=16: { id: 16, folder: 'django-api-backend', family: 'API/Backend', useCase: 'General REST backend', framework: 'Django + DRF', runtime: 'Python', technologies: ['django-allauth','PostgreSQL','Stripe','OpenAPI'], auth: 'allauth/token auth', data: 'PostgreSQL', monetization: 'Stripe', integrations: ['OpenAPI'] }
Create the basic Django project structure using django-admin startproject: a config/ package (settings.py, urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py) and the app modules directory structure
Verify `uv sync` and `uv run python manage.py check` succeed
acceptance_criteria: django-api-backend/pyproject.toml exists with exact-pinned Django, DRF, allauth, drf-spectacular, stripe, and all dev dependencies
django-api-backend/starter.json matches catalog entry for id=16
`uv sync` succeeds in the django-api-backend directory
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv sync && uv run python manage.py check
findings: All dependencies resolved successfully. Django 5.1.7, DRF 3.15.2, allauth 65.4.1 installed. Used ACCOUNT_LOGIN_METHODS instead of deprecated ACCOUNT_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD. uv sync and manage.py check both pass cleanly. Python 3.12.13 used via pyenv.
